creator: Alexander Terp
description: A nested claude -p, or a tmux server started in a pane, inherits MUSTER_PANE and MUSTER_DAEMON and can report state for the outer agent (documented as a limit in MIP-3 section 8 and the plugin README, with an env -u MUSTER_DAEMON workaround). The daemon could read the sender's pid off the socket (LOCAL_PEERPID, SO_PEERCRED) and accept a state report only when its nearest agent ancestor is the pane's identified agent; that needs a parent lookup and ancestor identification in muster-detect's process probe, and a wrong answer drops a real report.
title: Accept an agent's state report only from the pane's own agent
